<!-- pr-reviewer: a40c158fe49a4d04e252f8078adaaec7883e7c5b -->
**Needs changes before merge** - one reader still takes the document pose in an aligned setup (the work-offset "model bounds" anchors). Everything else checked out.

### What looks good
- Merges cleanly with current main (already up to date); no build.rs, scripts, workflow or dependency changes.
- The refusal gate is an allow-list: `setup_align::verified_kind` (`crates/app/src/setup_align.rs:312`) names Face, Pocket, Contour and Adaptive2D, so every other and every future kind is refused by default. It is read at `collect_job` (`operation/job.rs:122`). Picks, area controls, tilt and non-mill machines are refused by name in the same function (`setup_align.rs:331-349`).
- I grepped every reader of `transform_of`, `world_facets`, `entity_world_aabb`, `solid_world_aabb` and `facets_of` in app and ui. The generation path (`material.rs`, `heights.rs`, `heights_sel.rs`, `stamp.rs`, `set_stock.rs`, `stock_sim::part_facets`) goes through the setup-frame helpers. The remaining document-pose readers feed refused paths, setup furniture (stock, fixtures, offsets), or display and sizing only. The stock is not a "model" (`is_model` excludes it), so it is never double-transformed.
- Work offset untouched: `wcs_slot` and `posting::wcs_context` are unchanged, and the test asserts G54.
- Flip/turn math: `axis_quat` is exact for quarter turns. Pivot is the parts' bounds centre (`p' = R(p-c)+c`). The stock delta `next * prev^-1` is right, and the pinned numbers (flip X gives rot `[1,0,0,0]`, translation `(0,0,20)`; stock 60x60x22 from Z 0; Turn 90 gives a 40x60 box) agree with the math. The cylinder-on-its-side and shared-stock refusals are present.
- Identity is absence: `None` writes nothing into stamps or files, and all goldens are unchanged and pass. Undo restores the stock exactly.
- Project v53: v52 loads as modelled, a non-rigid transform is refused as corrupt. Not breaking is reasonable.
- No new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in the diff. New modules carry provenance lines. The alignment is a command with validation at construction.

### Local results (merged with main, own target dir)

|---|---|
| setup_align | 8 passed |
| golden_cl | 23 passed |
| conformance | 6 passed |

| operations | 117 passed, 6 ignored (heavy lane) |
| camcraft-ui lib (CWD crates/ui) | 291 passed, 2 ignored |
| clippy -D warnings, app and ui | clean |

### Requested before merge
1. **`crates/ui/src/interact.rs:474-476` (`anchor_reference`) reads the document pose in an aligned setup.** The "model bounds" choice uses `model::solid_world_aabb` (document frame), and `anchor_points` (`:489`) turns that into the corner and centre points the work-offset pick places G54 on. In an aligned setup the part is drawn in the setup frame (`view_pose`), so the anchors land on a box that is not the one on screen. A Turn 90 of a non-square part, or any non-centred pivot, puts the origin at the wrong place relative to the part, and the operator touches off a different corner than the program assumes. This is a silent wrong origin. Fix: use `camcraft_app::setup_align::solid_aabb_in(world, active.as_deref())` here (and for the stock fallback if you want symmetry), and add a UI test that a turned setup's "model bounds" anchors equal the turned part's corners. If you would rather not touch it in this slice, refuse the "model bounds" anchor in an aligned setup with a named message instead.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The setup sheet (`setup_sheet/sections.rs`) prints stock, offsets and fixtures, all of which live in the setup frame, so it is not wrong. But it never says the setup holds the part turned. A one-line "Part alignment: Flip over X" there would help the operator. The PR already lists the sheet and the move gizmo as known gaps, and I do not consider the sheet a blocker.
- `ui/src/interact.rs` gizmo and chevron sizing and `plane_rect` still use document bounds. They are display scale only, so harmless; worth moving to the setup frame when #330 lands.
- Size growth on files already over ~400 lines: `ui/src/state.rs` (3795, +28), `project/entity.rs` (511, +33), `stock_sim.rs` (413, +31). Not blocking.
- `part_facets` error text in `stock_sim.rs` contains a long run of spaces in the middle of the message (a line-continuation artifact); the message will print with a wide gap.
- Process: body ends `Fixes #326`, has a `Changelog:` line, decisions file present, no CHANGELOG.md edit. Good.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (re-review of the delta a40c158..24c432a).

**Blocker from the last review: fixed**
- `anchor_reference` (crates/ui/src/interact.rs:481) now reads `setup_align::solid_aabb_in(world, active)` for "model bounds". The pane buttons, viewport markers and click pick all go through `anchor_points` (interact.rs:498, :916, pages.rs:641), so they agree.
- `model_bounds_anchors_follow_the_aligned_part` (setup_align_tests.rs) pins SW/NE/C for as-modelled, flip X, turn Z 90 and flip+turn, compares against transformed corners, and checks that G54 set from the SW anchor lands at (-10,-20,0). The quarter turns would have caught the old bug. After resetting the alignment, the anchors equal the untouched ones.

**Unrequested change: stock anchor now `stock_world_aabb_for(active)`: acceptable**
- Matches the maintainer rule that program zero comes from the setup being edited. Heights and boundary code already use the same function with the setup name, and `SetWcs` writes to the active setup, so offered anchors and the stored G54 now share one setup.
- With one or no declared setup this is byte-identical to the old document stock (`None` law, model.rs:381). With several setups, each now anchors on its own stock, which is the right result. The stock is setup furniture and is not turned by the part alignment, so no double transform.
- No test pins the multi-setup case directly. The existing `law_tests` anchor tests still pass. A small multi-setup stock-anchor test would be nice but is not blocking.

**Setup sheet**
- `describe`/`preset_of`/`angles_of` moved to `setup_align` and are shared with the Setups page. As-modelled prints nothing and the goldens are unchanged. `the_setup_sheet_names_the_part_alignment` covers it. The sim-refusal string also lost a stray run of spaces.

**Laws:** no new unwrap/expect/panic in the delta (tests aside). The active-setup choice for anchors is correct. Layering is intact (the UI re-exports the app functions).

**Local results (merged with current origin/main, clean merge)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| app setup_align | 9 passed |
| wcs_align | 5 passed |
| setups | 11 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| golden_cl | 23 passed |
| pick | 9 passed |
| setup_sheet | 7 passed |
| setup_wcs | 7 passed |
| setup_defines_wcs | 4 passed |
| ui lib (from crates/ui) | 292 passed, 2 ignored |
| clippy -D warnings, app and ui | clean |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking):** `solid_world_aabb` (document frame) is still used for view extent at interact.rs:587/:1052/:1603. That is a view/framing use, not a G54 placement, so I left it alone.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
